authority.statement: Pour les payloads core.*@1, Blue est l'autorité normative et l'implémenteur conforme (ADR 013 §3.6, R6 §6.6).

normalization: no whitespace trim — a padded value uppercases to something containing a space, which the token grammar below then rejects, exactly like the Orion transport it mirrors
method.token_grammar: RFC 7230 §3.2.6 tchar — no verb allowlist: any non-standard-but-token-shaped method (e.g. PURGE, PROPFIND) is valid and must pass

body.bound: the contract fixes the accepted SHAPE of body (object, array, string, or absent) — it does not fix an effective byte-size cap. The numeric cap, like the rest of egress policy, is the host's (see non_objective below).

non_objective.statement_fr: La conformité à la fixture ne vaut jamais autorisation.
non_objective.scope: This contract fixes the FORM and NORMALIZATION of a request, never the egress policy. SSRF, egress allowlisting, redirects, DNS rebinding, the effective body-size bound, and the choice of HTTP client remain entirely the host's responsibility (ADR 013 §3.6).
non_objective.orion_ownership: internal/effects (*effects.EgressPolicy, wired at deploy by SetHTTPEffects); internal/bluehost/http_transport.go is only the call site, and the path is fail-closed when the policy isn't wired (internal/bluehost/effect_http.go:57-59, tested by internal/bluehost/effect_http_integration_test.go:313).
